verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships an official CLI (`npm install -g @hubspot/cli && hs init`), documented with install/auth/build steps, and it's a first-class tool used to scaffold and manage projects, including agentic development flows via the Developer MCP server which itself is CLI-based. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of CLI usage and depth of CLI command coverage beyond install/init.
